scenes.stage_direction: Calls and protected interviews interrupt the search. Amara asks practical questions about Ethan's care before she asks about blame.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Her account matches the access records.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Then we have stopped guessing about the house.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: And Kellan's authorisation is on the transfer she was given.

metadata.evidence_summary: The access conspiracy no longer rests solely on Amara's account.
